description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for accessing teller journal data within the Apache Fineract project. It exposes an endpoint at '/v1/cashiersjournal' that allows clients to retrieve journal data filtered by office, teller, cashier, and date range.

classes.name: TellerJournalApiResource
classes.description: A REST endpoint resource class for retrieving teller journal data, utilizing injected service and handling GET requests with query parameters.

methods.name: getJournalData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch teller journal data filtered by officeId, tellerId, cashierId, and dateRange. Converts the dateRange string into a DateRange object and delegates data retrieval to the service.
